name: Hydro / dismemberment

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. A soaked limb detaches with a sharp wet fiber snap, a brief pressurized liquid squirt and heavy droplets. Crisp tear first, water after.
